text:
olivia: Heads-up: planning SDK v4.3.0 tomorrow 11:00 PT. Main items: deprecate `model_alias` in favor of `model_ref`, and remove legacy `rwi-legacy` CLI commands. Docs cookbook will include migration recipe.

ben: Will we provide an automatic mapping for `model_alias` -> `model_ref`? Lots of infra code references it.

olivia: Yes 1: a runtime shim will accept `model_alias` and translate to `model_ref` for 90 days. It logs a single WARN per process. After 90 days the SDK will error.

tara: Docs: adding `recipes/migrate-model-ref.md` plus snippet examples in Py/JS/Go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/451. Includes a grep-based helper: `rwi-cli replace-model-alias --dry-run`.

devops-bot: Note: deploy window reserved 11:00-11:30 PT. CI checks: docs-lint (rule: DEPRECATE_MODEL_ALIAS) will be WARN for 7 days then ERROR.

ben: What about Dedicated/Private? Some customers call the CLI from air-gapped machines.

olivia: CLI removal only affects `rwi-legacy` subcommands. We'll ship a compatibility shim that maps legacy subcommands to new ones for 6 months. For Private, ship an offline bundle containing the new CLI + migration script.

release-bot: Draft internal changelog: "SDK v4.3.0: model_alias -> model_ref deprecation (90d shim), rwi-legacy CLI removal with 6mo shim, docs migration recipe, linter schedule." Internal checklist: https://internal.redwood/releases/checklists/sdk-4-3-model-ref

tara: I'll add a Console banner for authors: "Model alias deprecated 1 migrate to model_ref; see recipe."

olivia: Thanks all 1 please review PRs before EOD. If any important partner uses `rwi-legacy` ping me so we can coordinate an exception.
